name: agent-changes-review
title: Reviewable changes
description: The fields an agent wants to change, each accepted or rejected before any is applied.

ReviewableChanges.description: One change per step of a DecisionCard; see above. Other props, `ref` included, go to the card's `div`.

props.name: changes
props.description: The fields the agent wants to change, as AgentSuggestionChanges takes them; add an `id` to each to key `value` by it.

props.name: title
props.description: The suggestion, in the header: "Update the Quanta deal". Without it, each change's field is the title.

props.name: description
props.description: A muted line under the title: "Based on today's call".

props.name: value
props.description: Each change's decision, by id (controlled). A change left out is pending.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The decisions to start from (uncontrolled). Everything is pending without it.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with every decision whenever one changes.

props.name: defaultStep
props.description: The change to open on, by its place in `changes`. Defaults to the first.

props.name: onApply
props.description: Apply: gets the accepted changes only, in their order, and every decision. Return a promise to hold the `applying` stage until it settles; if it rejects, review starts again.

props.name: onApplied
props.description: Called once the accepted changes are applied and the card has left: remove it here (it stays faded out until you do). Gets what `onApply` got.

props.name: returnFocus
props.description: Where focus goes when the card leaves with focus inside it: the record it updated, the next suggestion. Without it, or when it gives nothing, focus goes to the page's body.

props.name: status
props.description: Holds the stage yourself; without it, it follows `onApply`.
